scope: Actual local PostgreSQL with scripted inference and claim-source fixtures; no Minecraft token integration or live provider claim.

checks.name: strict proposal fields reject duplicates, escaped duplicates and privilege-changing actions
fresh authority/material checks precede a durable operation with a distinct id
concurrent attempts respect the durable last allowed inference request
two workers and a lost acknowledgement produce one synthetic bundle and one receipt
the receiving transaction fences an expired worker and conserves every material
a mismatched recipient cannot create a delivery receipt
